remarks: This fantastic location offers unparalleled convenience, ensuring you won't want to miss all it has to offer! Enjoy easy walks to Ridgeway Shopping Center, Scalzi Park, restaurants, and grocery stores. The property is also conveniently located near a bus line and just a short drive from the Stamford Train Station. The one-bedroom rental comes with a storage room on the lower level, complete with a washer and dryer for tenant use only. Heat & Hot-water included in the rent.
